correctness.rationale: Exact model and fixed quantifiers. Information bound gives upper values through six labels; explicit full binary witnesses attain each. Their exact branching recurrences rule out depth 12 and verify a complete depth 11 tree. Every positive leaf is checked against a distinct consistent order. The forest orientation argument proves VCdim=n-1 for all n.

value.rationale: The seven-label instance is the provably smallest failure of a natural factorial hypothesis-count upper bound for comparison shattering. This exact minimal cutoff changes the best possible realizable online mistake bound and differs mathematically from the sorting decision-tree objective; the all-n forest VC characterization provides structural contrast. Neither the cutoff nor its precision is arbitrary.
